visualCharacteristics.purpose: Grid of product/service cards with a generated "N serviços disponíveis" count, filtered by cards-category and search-services
visualCharacteristics.description: Large outlined search input with magnifier icon; horizontal track of 11 round icon chips with labels (Destaques selected, light blue); count line '10 servicos disponiveis'; 3-column grid of bordered product cards with image, optional badge (NOVIDADE / Compre e Ganhe!), category eyebrow, title, price label + price, optional instalment text, grey benefit box (20% de desconto com Cartao Porto Bank) and full-width blue 'Compre agora' button.

contentPattern.structure: one row per card. Cell 1: image. Cell 2: optional badge paragraph(s) (NOVIDADE, Compre e Ganhe!), category eyebrow paragraph (the last paragraph before the heading; comma-separate several categories), heading (title), price label paragraph ("A partir de"), price as a bold-only paragraph (**R$ 299,90**), optional instalment paragraph(s), benefit paragraph (the last text paragraph after the price), CTA link "Compre agora" alone in a paragraph. Do not author the count line; the block generates it
contentPattern.blockContent: Grid of 10 product cards (count line '10 serviços disponíveis' is computed)
contentPattern.source: One row per card: cell 1 image; cell 2 optional badge (NOVIDADE / Compre e Ganhe!), category eyebrow, H3 title (source H2), price label ('A partir de'), price (source H3; author as bold paragraph, not heading), optional instalment text, benefit text '20% de desconto com Cartão Porto Bank', CTA link 'Compre agora' to the detail page. The count text is generated by the block, not authored.

usage: Service listing grid (3 columns desktop, 2 tablet, 1 mobile). Shows an empty-state message when no card matches.
reuseGuidance: Reuse for any priced product/service listing. Works standalone (no filter) when no cards-category/search-services is on the page.
